Short Title and Commencement

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sales Tax (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002,
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, Sales Tax Act, 1990

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of section 3, Sales Tax Act, 1990.--In the Sales Tax
Act, 1990, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 3, in subsection
(1A), in the proviso in clause (3),--
(a) in sub-clause (iii) the word
"and" at the end shall be omitted; and
(b) after sub-clause (iv), the
following new clause shall be added, namely:--
"(v) substances registered
as drugs under the Drugs Act, 1976 (XXXI of 1976) and medicaments as are
classifiable under any heading of Chapter 30 of the First Schedule to the
Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), and"

Amendment of Third Schedule, Sales Tax Act, 1990

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
3. Amendment of Third Schedule, Sales Tax Act, 1990.--In the said
Act, in the Third Schedule, after Serial No.5, in column (1)-&d the entries
relating thereto in columns (2) and (3), the following serial number and the
entries relating thereto shall be added, namely:--
"6. Substances registered
as drugs under the Drugs Act, 1976 (XXXI of 1976), and medicaments as are
classifiable under any heading of Chapter 30 of the First Schedule to the
Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969).
Chapter 30."

SALES TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
Whereas it is expedient further

4. Amendment of Sixth Schedule, Sales Tax Act, 1990.--In the said

entires relating thereto in columns (2) and (3) shall be omitted.
